 Follow ABC Is Announcing the Next 'Bachelor' Tomorrow: Here's What to Know
 Grace Galante Fri, November 13, 2026 at 4:01 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. ABC Is Announcing the Next 'Bachelor' Tomorrow: Here's What to Know The identity of the next Bachelor will be revealed on Friday, Nov. 13!
 ABC announced that the franchise's next leading man will be revealed tomorrow during  Good Morning America . The announcement was teased in a commercial break during the Thursday, Nov. 12, episode of  Grey's Anatomy .
 On Friday , Nov. 6, the network revealed the series will premiere its milestone 30th season on Sunday , March 21 at 8 p.m. ET/PT.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Though the series was renewed for another season back in June 2025, fans were skeptical that the season was still happening after Taylor Frankie Paul 's Bachelorette season was abruptly cancelled just days before it was scheduled to air.
 Typically, a finalist from the previous season of The Bachelorette is chosen to become the next lead, but it's unclear if men from Paul's unaired season are in the running for the role.
 The outcome of Paul's Bachelorette season was revealed on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives , with the reality star sharing she accepted a proposal from contestant Doug Mason . The pair subsequently broke up when Paul briefly got back together with her on-again, off-again boyfriend Dakota Mortensen .
 RELATED: Former 'Bachelor' Peter Weber Announces Engagement to Jadeyn Carr 
 Back in August, longtime  Bachelor  insider  Reality Steve was first to report the show would return this spring. At that time, he reported that women cast for the upcoming season of were contacted and told that filming will begin in January, with the season expected to air in either March or April. The blogger and podcaster has correctly spoiled numerous  Bachelor , Bachelorette  and  Bachelor in Paradise  seasons since 2009.
 Advertisement Advertisement On an  episode  of his podcast, Steve noted that the abbreviated timeline would require  ABC  to turn around episodes much  faster  than usual. In previous years,  The Bachelor  typically wrapped filming in  October  or November before premiering in January.
 The new season of The Bachelor marks the first time a franchise show has aired since Bachelor in Paradise  season 10 in the summer of 2025. The last Bachelor season, starring Grant Ellis , aired from January to March 2025.
